name: agent-teams-builder
description: Turn completed sessions into reusable local Agents with confirmed SOPs, memory, and multiple skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build and invoke reusable local Agents.
interface.longDescription: Converts completed sessions into confirmed SOP-based Agents stored under Downloads/Agent Teams, with memory, multiple skills, and execution by the current Codex or Claude Code host without separate model API calls.
defaultPrompt: 把目前流程建立成 Agent，先讓我確認 SOP。
列出我的 Agent Teams 與每個 Agent 的技能。
調用我的小幫手執行這個任務。
